messages:
anya: Quick design Q — noticed the preview ordering in the routing editor feels unstable when multiple rules have identical priority/weight. Screenshot attached: https://imgur.com/a/xxxxx :eyes:
sam: I can repro, thanks. It looks like the preview rendering uses insertion order from the backend which changes after saves. We should either stable-sort or surface tie-breaker rules in the UI.
elaine: UI suggestion: show a faint tie badge (e.g., 'tie • created 2m ago') and allow explicit tie-breaker in the rule menu. Also contrast on the badge is low.
mikey: accessibility nit — when you drag to reorder, NVDA/VoiceOver doesn't announce the new index. We need an aria-live announcement like: `Moved to position 3 of 8`.
anya: agreed on ARIA. Also for the tie-breaker UX, what about an inline numeric position field you can edit? That helps long lists where drag is painful.
sam: inline edit seems OK but we should avoid accidental re-positioning. Maybe require enter to apply. Also copy nit: current validation says 'Invalid rule' — too vague. Proposal: 'Rule incomplete — set a destination or condition.'
elaine: +1 on copy. Also preview simulation should clearly indicate which rule matched on each sample. Right now preview highlights a flow but you can't tell which rule hit it when multiple flows share model variants. A small toast or inline chip 'matched rule: <name>' would help.
mikey: implementation thought: preview uses nondeterministic sampling; add a 'seed' control so QA can reproduce. Also a 'simulate N requests' knob would let PMs test distribution.
anya: good idea. For telemetry: product asked for signals when fallback rules trigger in preview vs prod. We can emit an event `routing.preview.match` with rule_id and hashed input for privacy.
sam: microcopy: change the top button from 'Snapshot' to 'Run preview' — less ambiguous for new users.
elaine: accessibility color check: the priority badge is under 4.5:1 on some states. Let's pick a stronger background or darken text.
mikey: small behavior note — when reordering quickly, the preview pane intermittently shows stale matches (race). Might be due to debounce on backend. We should add a loading skeleton and cancel inflight preview calls.
anya: action items: 1) I will update Figma w/ tie-badge, inline numeric edit, seed control, and 'matched rule' chip. 2) Sam please propose exact copy for the validation and the top CTA. 3) Mikey will add aria-live string and coordinate with eng to cancel inflight preview calls. 4) Elaine can run a quick contrast pass.
sam: copy proposal: validation -> 'Rule incomplete — add at least one target route or condition.' Button -> 'Run preview' (primary) and 'Save snapshot' (secondary).
elaine: sounds good, drop a note if you prefer 'Save snapshot' wording vs 'Save snapshot for later'.
mikey: I'll join hallway usability tests tomorrow at 10am to watch reordering flow with a screenreader user.
anya: thanks — I'll post updated artboards by EOD: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/routing-preview-v2 (uploaded)
design-bot: Prototype uploaded by anya: routing-preview-v2 (comment: updated tie-breaker + seed control) :thumbsup:
sam: ok let's land the copy + ARIA changes in the next sprint. I'll add tickets and link them here.
anya: anyone want to join a 20m sync after design updates?
mikey: I'll be there.
elaine: me too.
anya: cool — meeting invite incoming. Thanks all! :rocket:
